reports: lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — import now http-fetches each thread link via readability and drops createdat and the permalink body, silently changing the cli's output contract

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — topic creation now goes through topicembed.importremote, which does a live http fetch of every thread link via ruby-readability and returns nil for any non-http(s) link, so threads with unreachable/non-http links are silently skipped along with all their comments and the thread createdat is no longer honored.

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — p1/100: post = topicembed.importremote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title]) replaces the old postcreator.new(... raw: "\[[permalink]({t[:link]})\]", createdat: date.parse(t[:createdat]) ...), so the disqus importer now does a live http fetch of every thread link, drops the original createdat (topics get the import time), stores rawhtml instead of cooked markdown, and silently skips any thread whose link is not http(s) or fails to fetch; none of this was accepted as part of the embed-url task.
